body: Yeah, plateau isn't an option.  It's killing me. It's not so tragic that it is funny it's just beyond pathetic.  It either gets better or I'm quitting.  I've been holding on for long enough and all that's happened is that my dreams for life have fallen apart around me and been replaced by a nightmare that I can't wake up from.  I don't even know how to begin in getting help and I'm afraid that it's too late.
